newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Semperit 96 earnings jump, lifts dividend.
newsitem.headline: Semperit 96 earnings jump, lifts dividend.

text.p: Austrian rubber products maker Semperit AG Holding reported on Monday a robust set of 1996 earnings and said it would raise its dividend to 14 schillings from 10 in 1995.

Pretax profit climbed 43 percent to 162 million schillings, net profit gained 39 percent to 158.4 million while sales surged to 3.14 billion from 2.88 billion in the year-ago period, the company said in a statement.
For the full year, Semperit expects a pretax profit "significantly above 200 million schillings", it continued.

In the first quarter of the current year, Semperit raised pretax profit by 65 percent to 48 million schillings while group sales rose around eight percent to 800 million. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
